scientific_integrity: Analytic proof covers all n>=3; independently encoded finite checkers corroborate n=3..8 and n=3..14, respectively, and do not stand in for the proof. No external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arbitrary-root all-pairs distances and the radius/diameter of the complete reconfiguration graph are not asserted. Earliest confirmed source date derives from the public MFCS conference paper; a still earlier draft has not been established. Historical originality is assessed to best knowledge, not independently certified.
title: Quadratic geodesic detours in optimal cutwidth orders of cycles
